A Trans Bharat Aviation helicopter carrying a pilot and five passengers crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand on Friday. All six people on board died. The helicopter was travelling from Badrinath to Dehradun when it crashed near Marwari Bridge in Chamoli district.
